rationale: The English cue and both answers are valid for the intended medical sense, but the national split is materially overstated. Indonesian and Malaysian Malay both accept overlapping forms, especially radang and peradangan; keradangan is a Malaysian medical form, not an exclusive contrast. The relation should not remain different-common-word. No true false-friend contrast is established; Malay radang additionally has an anger-related sense, but its medical sense matches the cue.
